spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying in the land of the Magadhans, where east of Rājagaha there is a brahmin village named Ambasaṇḍā, north of which, on Mount Vediyaka, is Indra’s hill cave.

entries.description: Where is the Blessed One at present

spans.text: “Where is the Blessed One at present, the perfected one, the fully awakened Buddha?”

entries.description: the Buddha was at Indra’s hill cave
entries.subject: the Buddha

spans.text: Seeing that the Buddha was at Indra’s hill cave, Disvāna deve tāvatiṁse āmantesi: he addressed the gods of the thirty-three, “ayaṁ, mārisā, bhagavā magadhesu viharati, pācīnato rājagahassa ambasaṇḍā nāma brāhmaṇagāmo, tassuttarato vediyake pabbate indasālaguhāyaṁ.

entries.description: the Buddha emerges from that immersion
entries.subject: the Buddha

spans.text: ‘Tena hi, bhagini, yadā bhagavā tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhito hoti, atha mama vacanena bhagavantaṁ abhivādehi: ‘Well then, sister, please convey my message when the Buddha emerges from that immersion.’

Te amhākaṁ upaṭṭhānaṁ āgate amhākaṁ pāricariyaṁ gopako devaputto paṭicodesi: At that, Gopaka scolded them, ‘kutomukhā nāma tumhe, mārisā, tassa bhagavato dhammaṁ assuttha— ‘Where on earth were you at, good fellows, when you heard the Buddha’s teaching!

spans.text: For while I was still a woman I had confidence in the Buddha, the teaching, and the Saṅgha, and had fulfilled my ethics.

spans.text: When my body broke up, after death, I was reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

entries.description: Realized One arises in the world
